headline: Kutztown alone beat West Chester
dek: Kutztown beat West Chester for the third time this season, and those three matches are the only ones West Chester have lost. Against everyone else they have won fourteen times and drawn three.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals gather at the top end: Kutztown alone have scored more than California (Pa.), Pitt-Johnstown and Mansfield, the sides at the foot of the table, put together.

wire.line: Kutztown have scored 60 goals in all their matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: derived

last_match.line: West Chester have not scored against Kutztown this season.

next_match.line: Gannon have not lost since the first week of September, and Kutztown's last defeat came against Gannon.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
